proposed_contracts.documents: Resolve the complete current S7 source list by contract_number (source_id fallback), deduplicate physical targets, retain version/source identifiers, and never use capped canonical document_links_summary as completeness authority.
proposed_contracts.observations: Left-join stored observations to source documents by source_document_id; use exact source_document_url only as a legacy fallback; display unobserved documents and orphan observations explicitly.
proposed_contracts.price: OPEN shows initial_price as NMCK. AWARDED shows final_contract_price as contract amount and initial_price separately; zero is not treated as missing.
proposed_contracts.dates: OPEN start_date/end_date are procedure/application-window facts unless an explicit publication field exists. AWARDED uses explicit contract/delivery/execution fields; generic dates require provenance labels and must not be relabelled as publication.
proposed_contracts.contract_url: Expose only a factual source contract URL, currently the strict S7 document row named 'Информация о контракте' with an /epz/contract/ URL; do not synthesize it from tender_link.
proposed_contracts.history: Merge factual source, model, business, override, expert and audit events; sort by factual timestamp; preserve authority labels; suppress only exact duplicate event signatures.
